mapper.select: /* common.mdsr.selectMasterMdSrSrDetailPop */ SELECT A.SR_NO AS SR_NO, DECODE ( A.RECV_FLAG, 'GP', DECODE (#{st_user_id}, A.REQ_CONFIRM_ID, '결재대상', '결재중'), 'GB', '결재반려', 'GA', '요청', 'GS', '요청취소', 'DS', '접수', 'PS', '처리중', 'PA', '처리완료', 'PB', '보류처리', 'GG', '완료') AS RECV_TEXT, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_NAME, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SR01' AND CODE = A.SYS_TYPE) AS SYS_TEXT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SR02' AND CODE = A.REQ_TYPE)||(SELECT ' / '||TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SR05' AND CODE = A.REQ_SR_TYPE) AS REQ_TEXT, TO_CHAR (A.REQ_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REQ_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.REQ_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS REQ_TIME, TO_CHAR (A.PH_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS PH_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.PH_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS PH_TIME, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.FF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS FF_DATE, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.DF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS DF_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.DF_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS DF_TIME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.REQ_CONFIRM_ID) AS REQ_CONFIRM_NAME, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.REQ_CONFIRM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS REQ_CONFIRM_DATE, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.DS_USER_ID) AS DS_USER_NAME, A.REQ_REMARK AS REQ_REMARK, A.REQ_ATTKEY, A.DF_REMARK, A.FF_ATTKEY, A.USER_ID AS USER_ID, A.RECV_FLAG AS RECV_FLAG, A.REQ_CONFIRM_ID AS REQ_CONFIRM_ID, TO_CHAR (A.FF_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS FF_TIME, TO_CHAR (A.REQ_CONFIRM_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS REQ_CONFIRM_TIME, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SR03' AND CODE = A.RUB_TYPE) AS RUB_TEXT, A.RUB_REMARK AS RUB_REMARK, A.RETURN_REASON AS RETURN_REASON, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.CD_USER_ID) AS CD_USER_NAME, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.CD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS CD_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.CD_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS CD_TIME, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.DS_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS DS_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.DS_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS DS_TIME, A.SR_SUBJECT, A.REQ_DATA_BUYER , (SELECT CM.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CM WHERE CM.COM_CODE= A.REQ_DATA_BUYER ) COM_NAME_LOC , A.REQ_DATA_FROM_DATE, A.REQ_DATA_TO_DATE, A.REQ_TYPE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD1 WHERE COD1.TYPE = 'SR06' AND COD1.CODE = A.REQ_DATA_TYPE) REQ_DATA_TYPE, A.REQ_DATA_TYPE AS REQ_DATA_CD, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE+3,'YYYYMMDD') >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PASS_YN FROM KEPASRDT A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{st_sr_user_id} AND A.SR_NO = #{st_sr_no}

/* common.mdsr.selectSrResultList */ SELECT A.SR_NO AS SR_NO , A.REQ_REMARK AS REQ_REMARK , A.REQ_ATTKEY , A.SR_SUBJECT , A.REQ_SR_TYPE , A.REQ_DATA_BUYER AS BUYER_CODE , (SELECT CM.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CM WHERE CM.COM_CODE = A.REQ_DATA_BUYER)||'(' ||A.REQ_DATA_BUYER||')' AS REQ_DATA_BUYER , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REQ_DATA_FROM_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS REQ_DATA_FROM_DATE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REQ_DATA_TO_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS REQ_DATA_TO_DATE , (SELECT COD1.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD1 WHERE COD1.TYPE = 'SR06' AND COD1.CODE = A.REQ_DATA_TYPE) AS REQ_DATA_NM , A.REQ_DATA_TYPE FROM KEPASRDT A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{KEY_3} AND A.SR_NO = #{DOCU_NO}

/* common.mdsr.selectMasterMdSrExcelPoGr */ SELECT A.BUYER_NAME AS 구매사, --[01] DECODE(STOCK_CNT,0,A.STATUS_TEXT,'*'||A.STATUS_TEXT) AS 진행상태, --[02] A.PO_NO AS 발주번호, --[03] DECODE(A.BUYER,'KRDOOS0006',A.REF_IF_NO,A.LEGACY_PO_NO) AS IF발주번호, --[04] A.AGENT_NAME AS 협력사, --[05] (SELECT CMPY.IRS_NO FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = A.AGENT_CODE) AS 협력사사업자번호, --[32] A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS 품목코드, --[06] A.REF_PR_NO AS 관리번호, --[07] A.ADD_DATE AS 생성일, A.PO_DATE AS 발주일, --[08] A.RD_DATE AS 납기요청일, --[09] DECODE(NVL(A.GR_DATE,NULL),NULL,'',A.GR_DATE) AS 입고일, --[10] DECODE(NVL(A.DS_DATE,NULL),NULL,'',A.DS_DATE) AS 납품예정일, --[11] DECODE(NVL(A.INVOICE_DATE,NULL),NULL,'',A.INVOICE_DATE) AS 납품일, --[12] A.DELIVERY_DATE AS 확정일, --[13] A.DESCRIPTION AS 품명, --[14] A.SPECIFICATION AS 규격, --[15] A.MAKER_NAME AS 제조사, --[16] A.UNIT_MEASURE AS 단위, --[17] NVL(A.ITEM_QTY,0) AS 발주수량, --[18] NVL(A.GR_QTY,0) AS 입고수량, --[19] NVL(A.INV_QTY,0) AS 납품수량, --[20] NVL(A.DELIVERY_QTY,0) AS 확정수량, --[21] NVL(A.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS 매출단가, --[22] (NVL(A.UNIT_PRICE,0) * NVL(A.ITEM_QTY,0)) AS 매출금액, --[23] ROUND(((NVL(A.UNIT_PRICE,0) * NVL(A.ITEM_QTY,0))/F_GET_VATRATE_NEW(A.BUYER))) AS 매출금액_부가세 , --[44] NVL(A.GR_ITEM_AMT,0) AS 입고매출금액, NVL(A.AGENT_PRICE,0) AS 매입단가, --[24] (NVL(A.AGENT_PRICE,0) * NVL(A.ITEM_QTY,0)) AS 매입금액, --[25] NVL(A.AGENT_GR_ITEM_AMT,0) AS 입고매입금액, --[46] A.PO_DEPT_NAME AS 발주부서, --[26] A.PO_USER_NAME AS 발주자, --[27] A.REQ_DEPT_NAME AS 요청부서, --[28] A.REQ_USER_NAME AS 요청자, --[29] A.PO_SEQ AS 발주항번, --[30] A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS 주문항번, --[31] A.AGENT_CODE, --[32] A.CONTRACT_NO AS 계약서번호, --[33] A.CONTRACT_SEQ AS 계약서항번, --[34] A.BUYER AS 구매사코드, --[35] A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS 카탈로그관리코드, --[36] A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE1 AS 카탈로그관리명, A.PO_USER_ID AS 발주자ID, --[37] A.REQ_USER_ID AS 요청자ID, --[38] REPLACE(REPLACE(A.DS_REMARK,CHR(10),''),CHR(13),' ') AS DS_REMARK, --[39] DECODE(NVL(A.INVOICE_DATE2,NULL),NULL,'',SUBSTR(A.INVOICE_DATE2,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.INVOICE_DATE2,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.INVOICE_DATE2,7,2)) AS INVOICE_DATE2, --[40] DECODE(NVL(A.DS_DATE2,NULL),NULL,'',SUBSTR(A.DS_DATE2,0,4)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.DS_DATE2,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(A.DS_DATE2,7,2)) AS DS_DATE2, --[41] DECODE(SCM_REMARK,NULL,'','SCM') AS SCM_REMARK, --[42] --[43] A.CANCEL_REMARK AS 발주삭제사유, --[45] (SELECT IRS_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.AGENT_CODE) AS 협력사사업자번호, --[47]
A.BUYER_CATEGORY_NO V_BUYER_CATEG_ID, --[47] A.BUYER_CATEG_NAME V_BUYER_CATEG_NAME, --[48] A.BUYER_CATEG_PATH V_BUYER_CATEG_PATH, --[49]
(SELECT SG_NAME FROM KEPSGMG WHERE SG_ID = A.SG_ID) AS SG명, A.SG_ID AS SG_ID,
A.CMS_CATLG_ID AS 표준카탈로그, A.CMS_CATEG_ID AS 표준카테고리ID, --[50] A.CATEG_PATH AS 카테고리경로, --[51] A.REF_IF_NO AS I_F관리번호, --[52] A.PO_REMARK AS 비고, --[53] A.PROCESS_TEXT AS 거래유형, --[54]
A.ORIGIN_AGENT AS 실공급사코드, --[55] A.ORIGIN_AGENT_NAME AS 실공급사명, --[56] A.PO_REMARK_HD AS 비고2 , --[57 A.UNIT_TAX, A.LOG_TEXT, A.HA_DATE, A.WAREHOUSE_NAME, A.GR_NO AS 입고번호, A.GR_SEQ AS 입고항번, A.PR_NO AS PR번호, A.PR_SEQ AS PR순번 , A.BUDGET_DEPT AS 예산부서, A.ACCOUNT_TYPE AS 예산계정, (SELECT COD2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE COD2.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND TYPE ='Z014' AND COD2.CODE = A.ACCOUNT_TYPE) AS 예산계정명, DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'1' ,(SELECT MAX(SCHEDULED_DATE) FROM WMSIVDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS != 'D') ,(SELECT MAX(BUYER_DS_DATE) FROM ICOMPORS WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') ) AS KEP_납품예정일, (SELECT MAX(CD_DATE) FROM ICOMPORS WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS != 'D') AS 협력사납품예정일 FROM ( SELECT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, MAX(D.PO_NO) PO_NO, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME, MAX(H.PO_CREATE_DATE) AS PO_DATE, MAX(D.RD_DATE) AS RD_DATE, MAX(G.GR_DATE) AS GR_DATE, MAX(D.ITEM_QTY) AS ITEM_QTY, SUM(NVL(G.ITEM_QTY,0)) AS GR_QTY, MAX(D.UNIT_PRICE) AS UNIT_PRICE, MAX((SELECT C2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C2 WHERE C2.TYPE = 'C001' AND C2.COMPANY_CODE = D.BUYER AND C2.CODE = R.PURCHASER_DEPT)) AS PO_DEPT_NAME, MAX(H.PURCHASER_NAME) AS PO_USER_NAME, MAX(D.PO_SEQ) AS PO_SEQ, MAX(D.REF_PR_NO) AS REF_PR_NO, MAX(D.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO,
MAX(DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'0' ,(SELECT MIN(INVOICE_DATE) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <>'D') ,(SELECT MIN(INV_DATE) FROM WMSIVDT WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D'))) AS INVOICE_DATE, MAX(D.DS_DATE) AS DS_DATE, MAX(DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'0' ,(SELECT MIN(DELIVERY_DATE) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <>'D') ,(SELECT MIN(DELIVERY_DATE) FROM WMSIVDT WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D'))) AS DELIVERY_DATE, MAX(NVL(D.IV_QTY,0)) AS INV_QTY, MAX(NVL(D.DI_QTY,0)) AS DELIVERY_QTY, MAX(D.AGENT_PRICE) AS AGENT_PRICE, MAX((SELECT C2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C2 WHERE C2.TYPE = 'C001' AND C2.COMPANY_CODE = D.BUYER AND C2.CODE = R.REQ_DEPT)) AS REQ_DEPT_NAME, MAX((SELECT L.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR L WHERE L.COM_CODE = D.BUYER AND L.USER_ID = R.REQ_USER_ID)) AS REQ_USER_NAME, MAX(D.LEGACY_PO_SEQ) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, MAX(DECODE(R.STATUS, 'D', '발주삭제', DECODE(D.GR_QTY,'0',DECODE(SIGN(ABS(D.IV_QTY)),1,'송장생성',DECODE(D.DO_QTY,0,'수주미접수','수주접수')),DECODE((NVL(D.ITEM_QTY,0) - NVL((D.GR_QTY),0)),0,'입고완료','부분입고')))) STATUS_TEXT, MAX(D.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, MAX(D.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, MAX(D.MAKER_NAME) AS MAKER_NAME, MAX(D.UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE, MAX(D.LEGACY_PO_NO) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, MAX(D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE) AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, MAX(H.AGENT) AS AGENT_CODE, MAX(R.PURCHASER_DEPT) AS PO_DEPT_CODE, MAX(H.PURCHASER_ID) AS PO_USER_ID, MAX(R.REQ_DEPT) AS REQ_DEPT_CODE, MAX(R.REQ_USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_ID, MAX(D.CONTRACT_NO) AS CONTRACT_NO, MAX(D.CONTRACT_SEQ) AS CONTRACT_SEQ, MAX(D.BUYER) AS BUYER, MAX((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMGRDT WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D' AND AGENT = 'KR00000002')) STOCK_CNT, MAX((SELECT MAX(DS_REMARK) FROM ICOMPORS WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D')) DS_REMARK,
MAX(DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'0' ,(SELECT MIN(INVOICE_DATE) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <>'D') ,(SELECT MIN(INV_DATE) FROM WMSIVDT WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D'))) AS INVOICE_DATE2, MAX(D.DS_DATE) AS DS_DATE2, MAX(D.SCM_REMARK) AS SCM_REMARK, MAX(D.ADD_DATE) AS ADD_DATE, MAX(R.CANCEL_REMARK) AS CANCEL_REMARK,
SUM(G.ITEM_AMT) GR_ITEM_AMT, SUM(G.AGENT_ITEM_AMT) AGENT_GR_ITEM_AMT, --추가
MAX((SELECT CATEGORY_NO FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = D.BUYER_ITEM_NO)) AS BUYER_CATEGORY_NO, MAX((SELECT H.CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA H WHERE H.COM_CODE = D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND H.STD_CATEG_ID IN (SELECT CATEGORY_NO FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = D.BUYER_ITEM_NO))) AS BUYER_CATEG_NAME, MAX((SELECT H.CATEG_PATH FROM ICOMBYCA H WHERE H.COM_CODE = D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND H.STD_CATEG_ID IN (SELECT CATEGORY_NO FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = D.BUYER_ITEM_NO))) AS BUYER_CATEG_PATH,
MAX(D.CMS_CATLG_ID) AS CMS_CATLG_ID, MAX(D.CMS_CATEG_ID) AS CMS_CATEG_ID, MAX((SELECT CATEG_PATH FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CMS_CATEG_ID=D.CMS_CATEG_ID)) AS CATEG_PATH, MAX((SELECT SG_ID FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CMS_CATEG_ID = D.CMS_CATEG_ID))AS SG_ID,
MAX(D.REF_IF_NO) AS REF_IF_NO,
MAX( D.PO_REMARK ) AS PO_REMARK, MAX((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = D.PROCESS_TYPE)) AS PROCESS_TEXT,
MAX(DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'1',D.WAREHOUSE_CODE,'3',D.WAREHOUSE_CODE,H.AGENT)) AS ORIGIN_AGENT, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'1',D.WAREHOUSE_CODE,'3',D.WAREHOUSE_CODE,H.AGENT))) AS ORIGIN_AGENT_NAME, MAX(H.PO_REMARK) AS PO_REMARK_HD, MAX(D.UNIT_TAX) AS UNIT_TAX, MAX(H.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS LOG_TEXT,
(SELECT APPROVAL_RD_DATE FROM KEP_PO_DELY_MNG WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND SEQ = ( SELECT MAX(SEQ) FROM KEP_PO_DELY_MNG WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ ) )AS HA_DATE ,MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',D.WAREHOUSE_CODE))) AS WAREHOUSE_NAME ,MAX(G.GR_NO) AS GR_NO ,MAX(G.GR_SEQ) AS GR_SEQ , MAX(DECODE(NVL((SELECT COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_LEVEL = '1' AND COMORG_CODE = D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE),' '), ' ',(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE) ,(SELECT COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_LEVEL = '1' AND COMORG_CODE = D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE))) AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE1 ,MAX(D.SELLER_ITEM_NO) AS SELLER_ITEM_NO ,MAX(R.PR_NO) AS PR_NO ,MAX(R.PR_SEQ) AS PR_SEQ ,MAX(R.BUDGET_DEPT) AS BUDGET_DEPT ,MAX(R.ACCOUNT_TYPE) AS ACCOUNT_TYPE ,MAX(D.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT D, ICOMGRDT G, ICOMPOHD H, ICOMPRDT R WHERE D.BUYER = H.BUYER AND D.BUYER = #{st_req_data_buyer} AND D.PO_NO = H.PO_NO AND D.BUYER = R.BUYER AND D.PR_NO = R.PR_NO AND D.PR_SEQ = R.PR_SEQ AND D.BUYER = G.BUYER(+) AND D.PO_NO = G.PO_NO(+) AND D.PO_SEQ = G.PO_SEQ(+)
AND H.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND G.GR_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND D.PO_NO = NVL((SELECT MAX(PO_NO) FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER=R.BUYER AND PR_NO=R.PR_NO AND PR_SEQ=R.PR_SEQ AND STATUS ^= 'D'), (SELECT MAX(PO_NO) FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER=R.BUYER AND PR_NO=R.PR_NO AND PR_SEQ=R.PR_SEQ))
AND R.STATUS ^='D' AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND D.STATUS <> 'D' AND R.STATUS <> 'D' AND G.STATUS(+) <> 'D'
GROUP BY D.BUYER, D.PO_NO, D.PO_SEQ )A
